title: 周末购物

explanations.1: It indicates the day of the week, Saturday.
explanations.3: It shows the action is done together with mother.
explanations.4: It modifies the adjective 'big' to indicate the degree.
explanations.5: It emphasizes that everything inside the supermarket exists.
explanations.6: It indicates the completion of the buying action.
explanations.7: It is the measure word for apples.
explanations.9: It presents a choice between tea and water.
explanations.10: It negates the desire to buy the drink.
explanations.11: It indicates doing the action again (going to buy fish and eggs).
explanations.12: It indicates the time sequence after returning home.
explanations.13: It expresses the ability to cook lunch.
explanations.14: It refers to the mother who made the dumplings.
explanations.15: It shows that the dumplings belong to her (the ones she made).
explanations.16: It quantifies the large amount of food eaten.
explanations.17: It indicates the location where the action takes place (at home).
explanations.19: It is the measure word for books.
explanations.20: It indicates the location inside the room.

translation: Today is Saturday. I go to the supermarket with my mother to buy things. The supermarket is very big. Inside, there are fruits, vegetables, and meat. We bought several apples and bread, and also bought a cup of milk. Mother asked me if I wanted tea or water. I said no, because I don't like tea. Then we went to buy fish and eggs. After returning home, mother can make lunch. She made dumplings. They are very delicious. My father and I also ate a lot together. In the afternoon, I was at home reading that book. My younger brother was sleeping in the room. In the evening, we watched TV. Today is really happy.
